lines.speaker: herald
lines.subtitle: By the Truce of the Stilled Sea: first blood, and no further!
lines.text: By the Truce of the Stilled Sea: first blood, and no further!

lines.speaker: herald
lines.subtitle: For Aurivane, the Sunblade: Dacian Orrow!
lines.text: For Aurivane, the Sunblade: Dacian Orrow!

lines.speaker: herald
lines.subtitle: For Adamarch, the Diamond Wall: Seraphine Vael!
lines.text: For Adamarch, the Diamond Wall: Seraphine Vael!

lines.speaker: dacian
lines.subtitle: Nine years I trained for this sand.
lines.text: Nine years I trained for this sand.

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.subtitle: Then don't waste it.
lines.text: Then don't waste it.

lines.speaker: dacian
lines.subtitle: Yield, Diamond Wall.
lines.text: Yield, Diamond Wall.

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.subtitle: Walls don't yield.
lines.text: Walls don't yield.

lines.speaker: herald
lines.subtitle: First blood! Adamarch!
lines.text: First blood! Adamarch!

lines.speaker: dacian
lines.subtitle: Well struck.
lines.text: Well struck.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: They say he kept the peace for a thousand years. Not here.
lines.text: They say he kept the peace for a thousand years. Not here.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: Two cities on one strait. Aurivane, of gold. Adamarch, of diamond.
lines.text: Two cities on one strait. Aurivane, of gold. Adamarch, of diamond.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: Only the rich may live inside their walls. Only the strong may stay.
lines.text: Only the rich may live inside their walls. Only the strong may stay.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: Between them, one rock. Who holds it taxes every ship on the sea.
lines.text: Between them, one rock. Who holds it taxes every ship on the sea.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: They fought over it for a thousand years. For gold, and for glory.
lines.text: They fought over it for a thousand years. For gold, and for glory.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: He tried everything. He sent them gold, so they would want nothing.
lines.text: He tried everything. He sent them gold, so they would want nothing.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: They bought more ships. So much gold sank, they named the strait the Coinwater.
lines.text: They bought more ships. So much gold sank, they named the strait the Coinwater.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: He took us dragons away. They paid us more to come back.
lines.text: He took us dragons away. They paid us more to come back.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: I burned Adamarch for Aurivane, then Aurivane for Adamarch. Twice each.
lines.text: I burned Adamarch for Aurivane, then Aurivane for Adamarch. Twice each.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: The harder he held them, the more they slipped. So at last, he came himself.
lines.text: The harder he held them, the more they slipped. So at last, he came himself.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: He had never stepped into a war in the open. Not once in a thousand years.
lines.text: He had never stepped into a war in the open. Not once in a thousand years.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: He walked out, and the sea went still.
lines.text: He walked out, and the sea went still.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Enough.
lines.text: Enough.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: Every blade stopped. Every dragon came to his hand. Even mine.
lines.text: Every blade stopped. Every dragon came to his hand. Even mine.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: He gave them one duel a year instead of a war. First blood, and no further.
lines.text: He gave them one duel a year instead of a war. First blood, and no further.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: They bowed to him. Then they bet their cities on the duels. They saw only gold.
lines.text: They bowed to him. Then they bet their cities on the duels. They saw only gold.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: He left in anger, and never sat there again.
lines.text: He left in anger, and never sat there again.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: So he stopped holding the world alone, and raised four apprentices to keep it.
lines.text: So he stopped holding the world alone, and raised four apprentices to keep it.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Vessa. Malrik. The two harbour cities are yours now. Keep them in peace.
lines.text: Vessa. Malrik. The two harbour cities are yours now. Keep them in peace.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Of course, Master! No problem at all!
lines.text: Of course, Master! No problem at all!

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: None whatsoever.
lines.text: None whatsoever.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: They heard gold, and soldiers, for free.
lines.text: They heard gold, and soldiers, for free.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: Now his chair is empty. And I am home.
lines.text: Now his chair is empty. And I am home.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: So the old price stands. Whoever pays the most, I burn for.
lines.text: So the old price stands. Whoever pays the most, I burn for.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: And look who has come to bid.
lines.text: And look who has come to bid.
